comment.narrative: 1.Provided input for the review of the EU Responsible Minerals Regulation (aka conflict minerals regulation, or responsible minerals regulation). As the EPRM is an accompanying measure to this EU Regulation, the EPRM as a partnership is being evaluated as

1. Recommendations on how the EU CM Regulation can support local development. Developed with EPRM CSOs, submitted during BMZ-RMI conference, see conference report. 2. We made many suggestions to improve the implementation and impact of the covenant 3. Recommendations to RMI?s public consultation for their Global Responsible Sourcing Due Diligence Standard for Mineral Supply Chains. Joint submission with Women Rights and Mining (WRM) 4. With WRM we provided a ?gender-lens? review to the newly developed Forest-Smart ASM Standard and Guidelines as commissioned by the World Bank 5. "As a member of the Women?s Rights and Mining (WRM) coalition, Boukje took several initiatives in 2021 - either with other WRM members or individually - to advance gender inclusiveness during the annual OECD Minerals Forums. This contributed to the outcome that: Mid dec 2021, at the meeting of the OECD Multi-stakeholder Steering Group (MSG) to discuss the draft agenda of the 2022 annual OECD Minerals Forum, the OECD Secretariat stated to include gender and social inclusion as a point of attention in all speaker panels and main sessions of the 2022 OECD forum. OECD secretariat asked WRM to provide guidance and suggestions to the Forum sessions to ensure it is gender sensitive, both in content as in process.

1. [Gold] With WRM we advocated with the OECD minerals secretariat to further improve gender and social inclusivity during the OECD minerals forum 2022. All our suggestions were taken into account. Link to emails We also produced a fact sheet about gender and social inclusivity during the OECD minerals forums 2016 - 2022, showing that the gender gap in panel speakers is decreasing, but Western countries are still over-represented and most panel discussions are still gender blind. 2. [Gold] Provided input for the renewed vision and mission of EPRM 3. [Gold] Recommendations to OECD for inclusion of Voices from the South and Gender considerations throughout the OECD forum 4. [Gold] With the Global Gold Transparency Initiative we jointly sent an open letter to the worldwide jewelry industry urging them to be vigilant about their sources of gold, to avoid the Russian government using gold supply chains as a tool to evade sanctions and further subsidize their military aggression against Ukraine. https://globalgoldtransparency.com 5. [gold] Provided recommendations to the Responsible Jewelry Coalition for their Review of the RJC Chain of Custody Standard. Recommendations to a) narrow down the definition of the “recycled gold” so as to avoid the risk of misleading customers regarding the actual ESG impacts of recycling gold that is simply being re-refined, and b) expand the scope of mined material to include all legitimate ASM sources and encourage the recognition by the RJC of legitimate and transparent ASM assurance schemes. 6. [gold] with the NGOs of the Gold Covenant we did a reflection workshop and shared the report with reflections, insights and recommendations from the workshop with the RVO team Fonds Verantwoord Ondernemen Pijler 2.
